title: Is Graph Bipartite
statement: `graph` is an adjacency list of an undirected graph. Return true when the nodes can be colored with two colors so every edge joins different colors. The graph may be disconnected.
hints: A graph is bipartite exactly when it has no odd cycle.
BFS coloring: color a node 0 and every neighbor 1, then alternate.
A neighbor that already has your color means a conflict. Restart BFS from every uncolored node because the graph may be disconnected.

approaches.name: DFS two-color
approaches.explanation: The recursion carries the next color.

editorial: Store colors as -1 for uncolored and 0 or 1 for the two sides. When you first see a node, color it 0 and BFS. Each neighbor must accept the opposite color. If it already has the opposite color, the edge is fine. If it has the same color, return false.
